This pattern table is the DP application of the story. It carries the six platform H contracts H RWB-PLT-E1027-CON (DP-03), H RWB-PLT-E1042-CON (DP-06), H RWB-PLT-E1043-CON (DP-07), H RWB-PLT-TE006-CON (DP-09), H RWB-PLT-E1044-CON (DP-15) and H RWB-PLT-N001-CON (DP-19), and the same-service contracts RWB-P3-E1042-CON (DP-06) and RWB-P3-E1043-CON (DP-07), as DP-added. H RWB-PLT-E1072-CON and C RWB-P7-E1073-CON (DP-04) and H RWB-PLT-E1071-CON (DP-10) sit with patterns this key does not apply — rule packages stay with rwb-decision and no schedule is declared in 12.6 — so no row of the table carries them. Every row that is carried is either a wave-0 platform contract or a published contract built against as a fake, so no row blocks the story and Ready to start stays Day 1. The metadata rows Depends on (build), Contract dependencies, Integration dependencies and External dependencies stay as the Work Package fixes them and are corrected at the next version of the story set (GAP-1288; GAP-2398).
